status: exploratory; no hypothesis acceptance or advantage claim
fidelity: F=<psi|E(|psi><psi|)|psi>; squared Uhlmann fidelity for pure target
noise_location: one identical independent local channel per qubit, after ideal preparation, before exact observable evaluation
qubit_order: q0 is leftmost tensor factor; interleaved alpha/beta fermionic modes
references: plus/GHZ analytic controls; exact TFIM ground; Hubbard/H4 lowest N=n/2, Sz=0 sector eigenstate; assessment oracles only
spans: all complex S_ij=A_i†A_j and H_ij=A_i†H A_j rows separately, for fixed diagonal and mixed generator arms
generators: diagonal=[I,Z0,Z1]; mixed spin=[I,Z0,X0]; mixed fermion=[I,Z0,ca†cb+cb†ca], (a,b)=(0,2) for hubbard2 (alpha, sites 0-1) and (0,4) for h4 (alpha, spatial orbitals 0-2; the orbital 0-1 hop has zero S/H coupling to I and Z0 in the H4 reference)
observables: Z0, X0, Y0, Z0Z1, X0X1, Z parity, energy; particle number for fermions. Y0 makes recorded duality sensitive to the z_rotation sense
solver: solve_projected, tau_s=1e-8, max_condition=1e8; signed and absolute drift against the noiseless same-arm Ritz value, with a flag when the retained rank differs from that baseline
limitations: no device or resource advantage claim
